risks.risk: Year/trim/drivetrain mismatch (not actually 2024, not actually TRD, not actually 4x4). Photos do not confirm these specifics.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the vehicle VIN plate (dashboard VIN or door jamb) and the full spec sheet/registration showing year, trim, and drivetrain.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Toyota Tacoma V6 pickup with unknown trim/year and assume worst-case for value (not TRD/4x4 confirmed).

risks.risk: Engine/condition not guaranteed (could have mechanical issues not visible externally).
risks.proof: Request a cold-start video (engine start from overnight), plus a scan/OBD report screenshot showing no active faults.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified mechanically (worst-case: treat as needs inspection).

risks.risk: Accident/repair history not visible (front/rear photos can hide structural damage).
risks.proof: Request photos of undercarriage, chassis rails, and a panel/paint thickness check (or at least close-ups of welds and alignment gaps).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially repaired/unknown history (worst-case discount).

risks.risk: Feature claims (push-to-start, moonroof) may be false.
risks.proof: Photo of the push-button start area and a roof/overhead console photo showing the sunroof controls/opening.
risks.if_unproven: Price as without those features (worst-case: treat as not having them).

risks.risk: Duty/customs status may be unverified (risk of seizure/extra cost).
risks.proof: Request duty/tax clearance documents or import papers with matching VIN.
risks.if_unproven: Price as duty not verified (worst-case: buyer bears clearance risk).

proof_requests: Clear VIN photo (dashboard VIN or door jamb) + registration/spec sheet showing year, trim (TRD), and drivetrain (4x4).
Cold-start video + OBD/scan report screenshot (no active faults).
Undercarriage/chassis rail photos and close-ups of any repair points/welds + alignment gap photos.
Push-to-start proof photo (dashboard/ignition button area) and moonroof proof photo (roof/overhead console).
Duty/customs clearance documents with VIN match.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a Toyota pickup with a 'V6' marking, but the key details that determine the correct Abuja resale price (exact year, TRD trim, 4x4, and verified duty) are not provable from the provided images.
